convergence: All findings addressed in the finalized plan. 3-way consensus on F-001 (executable CLI), F-003 (--run-only run command), F-004 (lead-owned cross-repo edits), F-005 (two separate Ralph jobs). Copilot added F-012 (codex token-probe evidence) and F-013 (lowering inventory checks). Zero open Critical/High after revision.

findings.title: Increment 2 needs an executable src/scaffold-multi-repo-jobs.mjs CLI; skill alone is untestable
findings.detail: run.mjs runs node:test files, not skill prose. AC4/AC6/AC7 require deterministic generation a markdown skill can't provide; risks the same hand-roll failure.
findings.fix: Add src/scaffold-multi-repo-jobs.mjs CLI; the SKILL.md is a thin wrapper. Tests exercise the CLI.

findings.title: convert-to-ralph-prd --batch cannot set additionalDirs
findings.detail: additionalDirs is populated by an interactive Step-6 question, skipped in --batch; there is no --additional-dir flag. The 'other repos appear only in additionalDirs' claim is unsupported by the current converter.
findings.fix: Scaffolder post-processes each generated prd.json to inject additionalDirs[] (node write). Alternative (deferred): add a repeatable --additional-dir flag to convert-to-ralph-prd.

findings.title: Manifest run command --from-plan re-runs Phase 2 and overwrites the pre-seeded prd.json
findings.detail: The scaffolder pre-generates scoped prd.json seeds that the validator approves, but --from-plan runs Phase 0->2 which regenerates/overwrites the PRD.
findings.fix: Emit run command as $ralph-orchestration:implement-with-ralph --run-only --job <jobDir> --autonomous (skips planning, uses the existing prd.json). Verify --run-only executes stories on a fresh pre-seeded job.

findings.title: codexu wrapper edits (AGENTS.md + active-plugin-versions table) are outside the submodule target repo
findings.detail: Ralph writes one repo per job (the ai-developer-toolkit submodule). The codexu AGENTS.md 'Dual-repo plans' bullet AND the root active-plugin-versions table (CI invariant, must move in the same commit as the submodule pointer bump) cannot be impl stories without writing outside the target repo.
findings.fix: Remove codexu edits from US-002. Make them LEAD-owned wrapper ship steps (pointer bump + active-plugin-versions table + Dual-repo bullet), documented as the ship ceremony. This is the feature's own multi-repo split applied to itself.

findings.title: Autonomous run won't stop after US-003 for the Increment-1 ship + dogfood
findings.detail: A single --from-plan PRD/story list runs straight into Stage B; it won't pause for lead shipping, pointer bump, table update, and dogfooding.
findings.fix: Recommend TWO separate Ralph jobs: implement+ship Increment 1 (US-001..US-003 -> v5.61.0) first, then Increment 2 (US-004..US-008 -> v5.62.0). Make this the primary Next Step.

findings.title: Validator should check a structured write-scope artifact, not just prose
findings.detail: PRD criteria often omit paths; prose extraction misses cross-repo writes or confuses read-context citations with write intent.
findings.fix: Scaffolder emits a machine-readable writeScope/assignedPaths per job from the repo-map; validator checks that primary, with prose scanning as a secondary warning layer.

findings.title: Codex nested ship-gate sequence under-specified in the manifest
findings.detail: The exact ordered codex nested sequence is not a required manifest field: member inner worktree push -> inner SHA reachable on sandbox-patches -> canonical inner FF -> wrapper docs/gitlink commit on main -> push wrapper remotes.
findings.fix: ship-order-manifest schema requires the ordered shipGate steps; US-006 + AC6 require the exact codex nested sequence in a fixture.

findings.title: New schemas not validated anywhere
findings.detail: repo-map-schema.json and ship-order-manifest-schema.json are created but the plan doesn't validate emitted artifacts against them.
findings.fix: test-scaffold-multi-repo-jobs.mjs validates the emitted repo-map + manifest against their schemas.

findings.title: US-007 should depend on US-006 too
findings.detail: US-007 asserts nested-topology behavior from US-006 but only lists dependsOn US-005.

findings.title: Ship-order manifest discoverability
findings.detail: Independent seeds + manifest is right, but leads need to discover/resume the manifest.
findings.fix: Scaffolder records the manifest path in each generated job's prd.json/notepad (lightweight discoverability hook).

findings.title: AC7 must be concretely verifiable
findings.detail: 'test/inspection confirms no cross-repo push' is superficially satisfiable while shell snippets sneak into executable paths.
findings.fix: Assert the scaffolder CLI never invokes git push / pointer bump / rollback via mocked execFileSync; those strings allowed only in manifest text fixtures.

findings.title: AC6 must prove the codex token is REGISTERED, not just present in the string
findings.detail: A string-contains check of $ralph-orchestration:implement-with-ralph passes even if the token is wrong and codex still hand-rolls.
findings.fix: AC6 now requires a codex skill-list/registry probe transcript as evidence that the exact token loads the skill body.

findings.title: AC8 should explicitly require the codex-lowering inventory checks to pass
findings.detail: If the new skill adds Agent(/prose-delegation sites, AGENT_SITE_INVENTORY/PROSE_SITE_INVENTORY must be updated or the Codex generator test fails on drift.
findings.fix: US-008 + AC8 now require updating the inventories in the same commit and the Codex generator test passing with no drift.
